label: 炉台
prompt:
Create one isolated production-ready 2D game sprite for 茶园物语. Chinese ink and pale watercolor hand-painted style, restrained thin warm-grey brush outlines, clean broad washes, very sparse material marks. Match the approved reference palette: ivory, muted bamboo beige, pale brown, sage/tea green, charcoal grey. No noise, no paper grain, no dense texture, no muddy wash, no photographic surface, no oversaturation. Parallel axonometric camera, elevated view; long horizontal ground axis slopes up-right about 26 degrees, perpendicular short axis down-right about 30 degrees; verticals remain vertical, no vanishing points. Soft material shading only, no ground/shadow plate. TRUE transparent alpha background; no background color, no checkerboard drawn in image. One complete centered object with generous transparent margin. No scene, people, text, labels, UI, decorations or unrelated objects. Figma image is only palette/brush and workshop object inspiration; never reproduce its whole room, baked UI or people. Basket reference is palette and controlled brushwork only. Requested canvas is 1024x1024 unless stated otherwise.
SUBJECT: A small traditional Chinese brick tea stove BASE ONLY. Rectangular waist-high block in pale warm grey plaster with a few restrained brick joints. Raised flat top has one circular EMPTY burner aperture, visible oval in perspective; no cookware installed. On its FRONT-facing long side, one modest dark arched firebox opening, empty inside. Top long and short edges MUST follow the road's parallel axonometric axes, long -26deg short +30deg, vertical walls vertical. No attached wok, fire, embers, smoke, leaves, woodpile or tools. Single stove body only.
